A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
media coverage of policy agenda setting, development, and implementation of a new policy on antibiotic sales in Mexico was limited to a narrow set of stakeholders and issues.

the Mexican media did not adequately inform the public about antibiotic resistance, and that it did not adequately inform consumers of the risks of self-mediation with antibiotics, and that it failed to inform the public about how to use antibiotics safely and effectively.
a narrow media coverage of a policy on antibiotic sales regulation in Mexico was a missed opportunity for a broader discussion on the need for a comprehensive pharmaceutical policy.

the media can have a significant impact on the public debate about the regulation of antibiotics.
